what.a: We are an AI-powered IT services and products team. We run five software engineering lines: digital product engineering, digital insights and analytics, embedded and AI robotics, co-creation development, and application managed services.

different.a: Five things: an entrepreneurial spirit, delivery excellence across every layer of software from embedded systems to enterprise applications, metric-driven outcomes that validate ROI, an AI-powered agile development platform, and a cost-efficient partnership with skilled engineers in Vietnam.

where.a: You reach us in Plano, Texas. The engineers build in Ho Chi Minh City and Da Nang, Vietnam.

industries.q: Which industries do you know best?
industries.a: EdTech, healthcare, and logistics. We shape digital transformation strategies around the challenges and opportunities of each sector.

process.q: How do you run a project?
process.a: With a mature engineering framework: Agile practices combined with the BMAD-METHOD and the V-Model, supported by AI tools such as generative AI and prompt engineering. Project management is metric-driven, so you read quality and progress in numbers.
